notes.title: Ready Up: Rock the Rim Launches Any Moment! 🔥
notes.content:
Your story. Your rhythm. Your legacy.
The first chapter of André’s journey — and yours — is about to begin. 


This isn’t just about basketball. It’s about the choices you make, the notes you hit, and the life you fight to define — on and off the court.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/3520cd7de312fbe80f1fdb79f7eff652505ac77e.png"]

From intense court rivalries to private rehearsals and late-night writing sessions, Rock the Rim blends the fire of competition with the soul of music. Every decision carries weight. Every beat matters.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/5539769b2c43b2bf821bb7c13f078a450ecd5f7c.jpg"]
Original soundtrack, crafted to move you.

Rock the Rim features an evolving in-game soundtrack where characters express themselves through melody as much as through action. Whether it’s a quiet solo or an electrifying performance, music plays a central role in the journey ahead.


Stylized visuals, unforgettable characters, and a dual passion story told through both sound and sweat. Scroll down for new screenshots straight from the launch version.


This is your moment and it all begins right here.

CLICK HERE TO WISHLIST & FOLLOW — DON’T MISS THE DROP.
